lines.quote: Designed the beamforming front end for a 16-channel wideband digital receiver: per-channel digital down-conversion, time-delay beamforming with adaptive weight computation.
Implemented in C on a Xilinx Zynq SoC under bare-metal scheduling. End-to-end latency from ADC sample to beamformed output: <2 ms across all 16 channels.
It is about 8,000 lines of Python, tested with pytest, version-controlled, CI-gated, and used daily by five engineers besides myself.
